source: HierText CC BY-SA 4.0 official human line annotations
scope: Real HierText public scene text subset, oracle official line geometry; not document field quality, text detection or independent product acceptance

recognizer.backend: MIGraphX GPU; explicit host I/O; CPU resize and CTC decode
recognizer.scope: One fixed-shape compiled program per session; sequential lines, no text detector or model-quality guarantee.

recognition.backend: MIGraphX GPU; explicit host I/O; CPU resize and CTC decode
recognition.scope: One supplied line crop; preprocessing=paddle-bgr-resize-pad-minus1; dictionaryPolicy=paddle-en-v3-plus-space; compilation recorded once by session; confidence is not calibrated correctness. No text detector or orientation inference.

reference.scope: One supplied tensor/crop; abs <= 0.0001 + 0.0001 * abs(reference); not OCR domain accuracy.
